claim.summary: Nested word rank saturation. Let w in Z^d be nested: the positions of its nonzero entries have a non-crossing perfect matching M into pairs u < v with w_u = -w_v (zero entries are singletons); fix M. Let X_1..X_d be disjoint sets of noncommuting variables with |X_i| = 2^|w_i|. Define the factor sequence S(w): the empty word gives the empty sequence, a concatenation of blocks the concatenation of their sequences, a singleton at i the label x_(i,1), and a matched block (u, W', v) with q = 2^|w_u| gives, for a = 1..q in turn, x_(u,a), then S(W'), then x_(v,a). The product P_w of the factors 1 + x in the order S(w), a formula of product-depth one with 0/1 coefficients, has ordered set-multilinear projection (the part on the monomials x_(1,a_1)...x_(d,a_d)) whose partial derivative matrix, rows the monomials over the parts with w_i > 0 and columns over those with w_i < 0, has integer entries and determinant 1 over Z in the orders of the proof; so it is invertible over every ring with 1 and has relative rank 1 over every field, F_2 included. The number of factors is s(w) = sum over zero positions of the product of 2^|w_u'| over the pairs enclosing them, plus 2 sum over pairs pi of the product of 2^|w_u'| over the pairs enclosing or equal to pi. For the words w_Delta of Tavenas-Limaye-Srinivasan (ECCC TR21-094, eq. (5); k >= 1, r >= 3 odd, d' = r^Delta - 1) padded with zeros to length d >= d', s <= d' 2^(k(2^Delta - 1)) + d - d' <= d N^2, N the number of variables.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed with corrections by a fresh-context medium reviewer in two rounds: (a) by chain counts, Kronecker products for concatenations and block triangular matrices for matched blocks, with determinant 1 over Z and the adjugate carried along Z -> R; (c) by induction on the matching; (d) by prefix sums of the TLS words, B_(i+1) = 2B_i + k. Computations over F_2 on eight nested words (full rank), committed before their runs. Nested words only; the reviewer's unit-step construction for every path is computed full rank on 135 small paths and unproved.

formalization.scope: Informal proof or computation; no Lean verification.

significance.rationale: The relative-rank measure of the Tavenas-Limaye-Srinivasan noncommutative lower bound, applied to ordered set-multilinear projections, is already 1 on a product of factors 1 + x over F_2 itself, of product-depth one and at most d N^2 factors, for the padded words that bound uses; so that bound, read for inhomogeneous formulas, fails over the goal's field without the large integral domain that FLST Proposition 24 needs. It generalizes the interleaved control of thm:affine-component-ranks, the case (1,-1)^r. Balanced words without a nested matching are not covered.
significance.next_action: Decide whether every path of P_{k,d} has a product over F_2 of at most poly(N) affine factors whose ordered set-multilinear projection is full rank, first by the unit-step refinement the reviewer proposed (unverified).

claim.summary: Over any field, for P=sum_a lambda_a product_(j=1)^(q_a)(c_aj+ell_aj) in a free algebra, ell homogeneous linear, every degree-r component and nontrivial contiguous position cut 1<=p<r has coefficient matrix rank at most sum_a q_a. Group by the factor supplying the p-th selected letter; constants skipped, prefix degree p-1 and suffix degree r-p. Empty-sided cuts rank<=1, absent components zero. Therefore for each fixed graph maximum degree Delta the explicit binary complete ternary one-hot Tseitin certificate of binary-word-rank-witness, s=n+m+1, has contiguous component ranks O_Delta(s^3) after every binary affine substitution of its free letters; all original generator labels remain in underlying certificate, transformed object only analysis, no uniform growing-Delta or small fixed-depth binary witness asserted. Binary coefficient matrix rank agrees with F4 rank. In contrast H=degree-2r component of product_(j=1)^(3r)(1+X_j), r>=1, has odd/even position rank>=2^r over every field. Restrict odd letter i to X_(3i-2) or X_(3i-1), even to X_(3i-1) or X_(3i): submatrix is tensor power of [[1,1],[0,1]]. Original binary product has O(r) gate/wire formula size and depth2, so no generic polynomial interleaved component-rank upper bound holds for arbitrary shallow inhomogeneous binary formulas. Written affine substitution of max formula size a into size-S depth-d formula costs O(Sa), depth<=d+1; no free component extraction inferred. Fixed-degree and zero/constant controls retained. Does not refute a property restricted to matched small binary certificates, all-depth certificate hardness or Frege lower bound.
claim.assessment: Passed the sole fresh-context medium review of factor-position identity with constants/cancellations, exact cut/degree bounds, fixed-Delta complete witness, binary/F4 rank, tensor submatrix, written formula ledger, nonvacuity and degenerate cases. No mathematical correction or unused hypothesis. Same reviewer approved the retained exploratory next whole-correction task and Continuing parent/child. No matched-image impossibility, free homogenization or novelty claim.

claim.summary: Noncommutative homogenization lower bound (Fournier-Limaye-Srinivasan-Tavenas, ECCC TR23-191, Theorem 8 with Propositions 22 and 24): over any field, the ordered elementary symmetric polynomial E^d_n = sum over i_1<...<i_d of x_{i_1}...x_{i_d} in noncommuting variables, the degree-d component of the product (1+x_1)...(1+x_n), which has an inhomogeneous noncommutative formula of product-depth 1, needs size n^(Omega(d^(1/Delta)/2^Delta)) for homogeneous noncommutative formulas of product-depth Delta when d <= n^0.99, and (log n)^Omega(log d) at any depth when d <= n^(1-2/log log n). Proposition 22: a homogeneous formula for E^d_n gives a set-multilinear formula of the same size and product-depth for BE^d_(n-d+1) = sum over j_1<=...<=j_d of y_(1,j_1)...y_(d,j_d). Proposition 24: over an integral domain with at least d^2 2^(k(d+1)) elements, for every path p in P_(k,d) a set-multilinear projection of BE^d_(2^k d) has a full-rank partial derivative matrix.
claim.assessment: Imported established result; Theorem 8, Section 4.3, Section 7.1 (the statements of Propositions 22 and 24, the proof of Proposition 22, and the proof of Theorem 8's first part) were read in the held ECCC version. The proof of Proposition 24 was not read; the import rests on its statement. The STOC 2024 version was not retrieved and no ECCC revision is listed. The source writes BE^d_{nd} with n = 2^k in Proposition 24, read as BE^d_{2^k d} from the proof of Theorem 8. The source does not spell out how 'any field' covers fields smaller than Proposition 24's cardinality.

claim.summary: Ordered projection barrier: over every field F and for every fixed product-depth Delta' and constant c, no function f gives every noncommutative formula of size s and product-depth 1 an ordered set-multilinear projection, with respect to any ordered partition into d parts, computed by a homogeneous noncommutative formula of product-depth Delta' and size at most f(d) s^c. Witness: P = (1 + sum_t y_(t,1))...(1 + sum_t y_(t,n)), of size O(nd), whose ordered projection to (Y_1,...,Y_d), Y_t = {y_(t,j)}, is sum over j_1<...<j_d of y_(1,j_1)...y_(d,j_d); substituting y_(t,j) -> x_j turns a homogeneous formula for it into one for E^d_n of the same size and product-depth. So the noncommutative ordered analogue of Forbes's Corollary 27 fails, and no conversion of cost f(d) s^c, gate by gate or not, carries the Tavenas-Limaye-Srinivasan homogeneous noncommutative bound to inhomogeneous noncommutative certificates at constant depth; transfers specific to the certificates, or of cost s^(g(d)) with g growing, are not excluded.
claim.assessment: Working elementary corollary of imp:noncommutative-homogenization-lower-bound, passed by a fresh-context medium reviewer after corrections: Theorem 8 plus a renaming of variables and, over fields smaller than the source's cardinality bound, a passage to a finite extension. No independent novelty: the source's Section 3.3 names this lift as what efficient homogenization would give. Over F_2 at growing degree, cor:compiled-homogeneous-gap already excluded such conversions for goal-related images; new here are constant d and other fields. It refutes a transfer method, not hardness of any certificate class.

claim.summary: For every fixed-degree ternary one-hot Tseitin graph with nonzero total charge, s=n+m+1, there exists a binary original-input placeholder-linear noncommutative IPS certificate C of degree O_Delta(s) such that every degree-r word tensor flattened across any subset of positions has F2 matrix rank O_Delta(s^2), also after positionwise F2-linear tensor maps. C has a constant-depth F4 sum-of-products-of-homogeneous-linear-forms formula of size O_Delta(s^3). Use C=omega^2 D+omega sigma(D) for the earlier F4 certificate, with coefficientwise Frobenius fixing letters. No constant-depth F2 formula or membership in the matched shallow simulation image is claimed.
claim.assessment: Working all-parameter rank witness, passed by the sole fresh GPT-6.1-Sol medium reviewer. Refutes the large-rank premise for all certificates, not a premise restricted to already-small binary certificates or the matched image.
